data.name: 6-Passenger Capacity Signature Dolphin and Whale Watching Trip (2.5hrs approx.)
data.headline: Our Flagship Experience | 6-Passengers Max | Min Age 5
data.description:
With a 6-passenger limit on every public tour, we are committed to giving you the very best, intimate whale watching experience available in San Diego! We cover the most ocean on a 2.5 hour trip of any offering in San Diego, giving you the very best odds to encounter whales and dolphins on your tour!

For private charters please call us to book!

If you’d like to leave a gratuity for the crew at the end of your trip, cash is strongly preferred due to the new regulations around venmo!

meeting_point.address: 1617 Quivira Rd San Diego, CA US 92109

data.what_is_included: - The tour includes a approx. 2.5-hour, small-group whale-watching excursion aboard San Diego’s most far-ranging boats, maximizing your odds of intimate encounters with whales and dolphins.
data.what_to_bring: DRESS WARM NO MATTER THE WEATHER, MANY LAYERS REQUIRED, EVEN IN SUMMER! Our crew always wears a winter jacket, even in July when its 80+ degrees on land.
data.cancellation_notes: We have a strict no-cancellation policy.
data.booking_notes:
## More Information

DRESS WARM!! Even in the summer our crew wears 2-3 layers plus large winter jackets. It can be 80 degrees and sunny at the dock, while on the ocean it can feel 30+ degrees colder due to our speed of travel, marine layer, and ocean wind. If its one of the rare days it is actually warm on the water, you can simply take your layers off.

Please arrive a minimum of 30 minutes before the tour start time as parking can occasionally be difficult around Mission Bay. Our pick up location is the dock in front of Sportsmen's Seafood. 1617 Quivira Rd, San Diego, CA 92109.
Please do not park in the lot designated for restaurant patrons only! Feel free to call us at 858 500 2568 with any questions.
___________
### What to Bring 

- Winter Jacket 
- Sunscreen
- Sun Glasses
___________
data.check_in_details: We will embark on a 2-2.5hr (usually shorter in the winter and longer in the spring-fall) whale watching adventure from the dock located directly in front of Sportsmen's Seafood. The address is 1617 Quivira Rd, San Diego, CA 92109, USA. During our trip you will have the best chance available in San Diego to spot dolphins, whales, and any other marine life swimming in the open ocean.
data.restrictions: Please note our vessels are extremely fast and can encounter the occasional bump on the open ocean. For this reason, we do not recommend these trips for anybody with back or neck problems. We also do not allow children under 5 years of age, passengers that are pregnant, or passengers that are unable to board and exit the vessel without assistance (call for further clarification). You assume all risk and release Gone Whale Watching Inc. of any liability by boarding our vessels.
